
## What is RStudio?

RStudio is an Integrated Development Environment (IDE) for R that provides a graphical interface for the R software.

RStudio makes it easier to:  

  * write and run code 
  * preview plots and reports
  * keep projects organized\footnote{using the RStudio project feature} 



## What is Posit Cloud?

Posit Cloud is a cloud-based solution that hosts the RStudio IDE so it can be accessed from your browser.

Advantages:

* Key applications are already installed
* Standard hardware for everyone
* Helpful interaction features

This is our primary software in this course.  


## R, RStudio, and Posit Cloud -- what is the difference?

*  First time users of R are often confused as to the difference between R and RStudio. RStudio is actually an add-on to R: it provides a user-friendly graphical interface for the R software.

* In this class, we use RStudio hosted in the Posit cloud which can be accessed directly from your browser.
